description: This file defines a Java interface 'SubjectId' which represents a subject's identifier within the Eclipse Ditto policies model. It declares methods for creating and retrieving parts of the subject ID, as well as related constants.

classes.name: SubjectId
classes.description: A Java interface representing a subject's ID in the Ditto policies model, providing methods for creating, parsing, and retrieving parts of the subject ID.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId using an issuer and subject.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId from a combined issuer and subject string.

methods.name: getJsonFieldDefinition
methods.description: Returns the JSON field definition for this SubjectId.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer part of the SubjectId.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Retrieves the subject part of the SubjectId.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the SubjectId.
